content.title: Review spec: configurable-branch (quality perspective)
content.description:
Review the draft spec at .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

Analyze from a testability and quality perspective. Comment with:
- Testability concerns
- Missing acceptance criteria
- Documentation requirements
- Edge cases that need coverage

Focus especially on:
1. Can existing tests be parameterized to run with custom branches?
2. What happens if you init with branch A, then try init with branch B without cleaning up?
3. Does the normalization produce any ambiguous or collision-prone names?
4. Are error messages clear enough for users who mistype branch names?

Do NOT implement — only analyze and comment.
